notes: Version 2.53 records white paper 3.18. Appendix A.11 now restates the companion gravity paper's conditional result: under its completion conditions and the open coherence-extensivity hypothesis, the determinantal Born–Infeld density is an admissible, not uniquely selected, completion of a supplied Einstein term, and the saturation condition selects the Ricci endomorphism as carrier; the Einstein term is not derived from the coherence functional. Appendix A.12 states the Newton coupling as an open matching problem; the former formula for G_eff in terms of c_BI and ħ_χ, and its presentation as a robust prediction, are withdrawn. The relation K_0 χ_c^2 ~ c^4/(16πG), whose only stated basis was the former A.11–A.12 normalisation and which, in none of the white paper's stated conventions, is dimensionally compatible with its definition of ħ_χ, is withdrawn, together with the expression of G_eff in Appendix D.1 and the K_0 and ħ_χ estimates of the cosmological cascade section and Appendix D that depended on it. No paper status, graph node or edge changes.
